notes.title: The Grand Opening – "What's on the Menu?" is now available!
notes.content:
The Big Day is Here!

Hello everyone,

The day has finally come! I’m incredibly proud (and a little emotional) to announce that What's on the Menu? is officially launching today on Steam! This journey has been an amazing adventure, and after months of development, polishing, and feedback from the community, I can finally share the full game with you.

If you’ve ever dreamed of running your own restaurant, crafting the perfect menu, and tackling the challenges of the restaurant business, then your time has arrived! From managing your team to balancing finances and adapting to unexpected events, What's on the Menu? is a full-fledged restaurant simulation experience that will test your management skills.

What Awaits You in "What's on the Menu?"


 Build & Customize – Design your own restaurant, from furniture to decor.
 Craft Unique Menus – Choose ingredients, create dishes, and balance quality with cost.
 Hire & Train Your Team – Find the best employees and improve their skills.
 Progress Through Different Levels – Unlock new restaurants and new challenges as you grow.


Each level brings its own theme, from classic French bistros to fast-food chains and even international cuisines!

Thank You for Your Support!

As a solo developer, bringing this game to life has been a massive challenge, but seeing the excitement and feedback from players has made every moment worth it. Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have helped shape What's on the Menu? into what it is today.

I’d love to hear your thoughts! Share your restaurant setups, menus, and best strategies in the Steam Community Hub or join the discussion on Discord!

Ready to take on the challenge?


 Play now!
 Wishlist & Share: It helps a lot!


Thank you all for being part of this journey. Now, let’s see what’s on your menu!
